method: fresh bounded recovery total-target soft actor-critic with learned state-dependent latent mean/log-standard-deviation and learned entropy temperature
structural_difference: Not R198 whole-policy finite-difference or extra parameter directions: no proposals/antithetic parameter search.

Not extension of R197 deterministic TD3: reparameterized stochastic actor, trainable log-standard-deviation, entropy in Bellman and policy objectives, learned temperature; no target actor, target smoothing clip, or delayed actor schedule.
Not R196 on-policy PPO/MC likelihood ratios, R181 action-score PG, fixed recurrent-readout/CEM, R195 online sensor-dynamics RLS/MPC, geometry/phase/momentum/bias or old gain/node searches.
hypothesis: The learned stochastic density and entropy-regularized soft policy improvement may behave differently from the failed deterministic and parameter-probe rules. This is a new finite test, not a claim of physical robustness, safety, Markov sufficiency, convergence, or improvement.
